title: Saint Dominic, Priest
short_summary: Saint Dominic is honored by the Order of Preachers as its founder, a priest whose life joined preaching, study, prayer, evangelical poverty, and mission for the service of the Gospel.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps Saint Dominic as a solemnity on August 8.
The Order of Preachers honors him as Our Holy Father Dominic.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says Dominic was born at Caleruega in Spain around 1172-1173.
Benedict XVI described Dominic as founder of the Order of Preachers and a man of prayerful apostolic zeal.
This Dominican solemnity is shown as a proper calendar observance and does not replace the general U.S. calendar day.

sections.heading: Founder of the Preachers
sections.body: Dominic gathered a community ordered toward preaching the Gospel, study, prayer, and common life. The Dominican tradition remembers him as a father whose mission served the Church.

sections.heading: Truth with a missionary heart
sections.body: Dominican preaching is not argument for its own sake. It seeks the salvation of souls by speaking the truth of Christ with charity, clarity, and patience.

sections.heading: Prayer, study, and poverty
sections.body: The Dominican way holds together prayer, study, community, and evangelical poverty. These are not separate interests, but a single pattern of life ordered toward preaching.

sections.heading: A solemnity for the Dominican family
sections.body: The app presents Saint Dominic's solemnity as a proper observance for Dominican users. The general U.S. calendar remains the primary calendar day.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Truth for the sake of souls
catholic_connection_sections.body: Dominic's witness shows that doctrine, prayer, poverty, and mercy belong together in the Church's mission.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Mission born from contemplation
catholic_connection_sections.body: Dominican life is ordered toward sharing the fruits of contemplation. Prayer and study are meant to become a gift for the Church.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: A family in the Church
catholic_connection_sections.body: His solemnity is local and proper for the Dominican family while remaining within the Church's wider liturgical life.
